title: Bicep extension catalogue
description: Central configuration listing the Bicep extensions included in the catalogue.

extensions.description: The extensions to include in the catalogue.

id.description: Stable identifier, used for file names and site URLs.

displayName.description: Human readable name shown in the catalogue.

description.description: Short summary shown on catalogue cards and the extension overview page.

artifact.description: OCI artifact path, without a tag. The latest published version is resolved automatically.

publisher.description: Person or organisation that publishes the extension.

category.description: Grouping used to organise the catalogue.

tags.description: Free-form keywords used for filtering and search.

license.description: SPDX licence identifier of the extension source.

samples.description: Example .bicep files, fetched and embedded when types are refreshed.

docsUrl.description: Optional link to documentation hosted outside this catalogue.

description.description: One-line summary of what the sample demonstrates.

url.description: Link to a .bicep file. GitHub blob URLs are resolved to their raw content.
